about: An open source CRM for sales, marketing and customer support.

prs.title: Contact picker works for company names with an ampersand
prs.broken: Picking a contact on a contract, quote or invoice for a company like AtoZ & Co cut the name at the ampersand, so the list showed contacts from other companies.
prs.changed: The company name is now sent safely in all three screens.
prs.matters: Sales staff pick the right contact without scrolling through other companies.
